import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static long[][] p;
    static long[][] pro;
    static int[] bpt;
    static long[][] q;
    static int[] id;
    static List<List<Integer>> vec;
    static Map<Pair, Integer> mp;

    static class Pair {
        int now;
        long st;

        Pair(int now, long st) {
            this.now = now;
            this.st = st;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return now == pair.now && st == pair.st;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(now, st);
        }
    }

    static long power(long a, long n, long mod) {
        long ans = 1;
        long base = a % mod;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static long calc(int now, long st, Map<Pair, Integer> memo) {
        if (st == 0) return 0;
        if (now == n) return 1;
        Pair key = new Pair(now, st);
        if (memo.containsKey(key)) return memo.get(key);
        long ans = 0;
        int size = vec.get(now).size();
        for (int j = 1; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            long nst = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                if ((st & (1L << k)) == 0) continue;
                int cur = vec.get(now).get(k);
                int nxt = j - (j & cur);
                nst |= q[cur][nxt];
            }
            long temp = (pro[now][j] * calc(now + 1, nst, memo)) % mod;
            ans = (ans + temp) % mod;
        }
        memo.put(key, (int) ans);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        p = new long[n][n];
        pro = new long[n][1 << n];
        bpt = new int[1 << n];
        q = new long[n][1 << n];
        id = new int[1 << n];
        vec = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            vec.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        mp = new HashMap<>();

        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long r100 = power(100, mod - 2, mod);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (val * r100) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                pro[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        pro[i][j] = (pro[i][j] * p[i][k]) % mod;
                    } else {
                        pro[i][j] = (pro[i][j] * (mod + 1 - p[i][k])) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            bpt[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int count = bpt[i];
            vec.get(count).add(i);
            id[i] = vec.get(count).size() - 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 0) {
                    q[i][1 << j] = 1L << id[i | (1 << j)];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q[i][j] = q[i][(j & -j)] | q[i][j ^ (j & -j)];
            }
        }

        long result = calc(0, 1L, new HashMap<>());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
